messages.subject: For Mostafa Terrab | Africa, government relations and sustainable resource development
messages.body:
Dear OCP Group Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Mostafa Terrab, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

OCP Group's position at the intersection of phosphate resources, agriculture, industrial development and African partnerships creates a strong need for disciplined government relations, stakeholder strategy and sustainability execution. My current role is built around that same interface inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operating functions, and translate external commitments into accountable internal owners and evidence. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating records.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of mining, government-relations, sustainability and country execution might support OCP Group's African or international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to OCP Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
